name: RES 2S/2M without final correction
plain: A trimmed extract of RES4LYF default RES paths without the implicit final correction. Includes noise swap and rebound helpers and a 100-pass stage refinement. Optional sharpness.
math:
Stages in RK form with φ-based a, b; x_stage=x0+h·Σb·ε. c2=½ for 2s or log(σ_step/σ_prev)/h for 2m. 2m uses history when step≥2 and h<1, Euler if h≥1 and σ<0.1.
reanchor, rebound, swap_noise (σ_up=½σ_next) per stage. Fixed 100-loop refinement when σ>0.03. See the RES4LYF tribute page.
